serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: MediaLab provides an integrated web-based SaaS platform for healthcare quality management. MediaLab's offering address many different areas of compliance within healthcare facilities, including continuing education and training, document management of policies and procedures, inspection readiness and accreditation management, competency assessment, management of personnel files and certifications, and management of non-conforming events, instrument maintenance, and quality monitoring data. Role-based permissions allow key users to access and update data across all applications to meet any healthcare facility's unique needs.
